crossrefs.text: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along; they set it in its place, and there it stands, not budging from that spot. They cry out to it, but it does not answer; it saves no one from his troubles.
You must keep My charge not to practice any of the abominable customs that were practiced before you, so that you do not defile yourselves by them. I am the LORD your God.”

You must not follow the practices of the land of Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not follow the practices of the land of Canaan, into which I am bringing you. You must not walk in their customs.
All makers of idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Their witnesses fail to see or comprehend, so they are put to shame.
He feeds on ashes. His deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?”
You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along; they set it in its place, and there it stands, not budging from that spot. They cry out to it, but it does not answer; it saves no one from his troubles.
Remember this and be brave; take it to heart, you transgressors!
What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it— or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ or to silent stone, ‘Arise!’ Can it give guidance? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, yet there is no breath in it at all.”
Disaster after disaster is proclaimed, for the whole land is laid waste. My tents are destroyed in an instant, my curtains in a moment.

And should someone pursue you and seek your life, then the life of my lord will be bound securely by the LORD your God in the bundle of the living. But He shall fling away the lives of your enemies like stones from a sling.
Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard; they have trampled My plot of ground. They have turned My pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.
Therefore, son of man, pack your bags for exile. In broad daylight, set out from your place and go to another as they watch. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious house.
And at dusk the prince among them will lift his bags to his shoulder and go out. They will dig through the wall to bring him out. He will cover his face so he cannot see the land.

“Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?

This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand from them My flock and remove them from tending the flock, so that they can no longer feed themselves. For I will deliver My flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.’
“Run for cover, O sons of Benjamin; flee from Jerusalem! Sound the ramʼs horn in Tekoa; send up a signal over Beth-haccherem, for disaster looms from the north, even great destruction.
A manʼs steps are from the LORD, so how can anyone understand his own way?
The plans of the heart belong to man, but the reply of the tongue is from the LORD.
The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.
Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
